from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ye-bali-sakina-hai.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
header, body = before.decode().split('\\n---\\n', 1)

    'sakina': 'Sakina',
    'Haye Sakina haye haye haye shaam': 'Haye Sakina haye haye haye Shaam',
    'tarpati': 'tarpaati',
    'Ye bali': 'Ye baali',
    'Zindaṅ': 'Zindaaṅ',

    'ye bachi': 'ye bachchi',
    'Kabhi maa kabhi': 'Kabhi maaṅ kabhi',
    'godhi': 'godi',
    'Masooma': 'Masuma',
    'masayab dekhe hai': 'masaaib dekhe haiṅ',
    'tamache khaaye hai': 'tamaanche khaaye haiṅ',
    'sina e shaah': 'sina-e-shaah',
    'Tumhe yaad': 'Tumheṅ yaad',
    'Ashur se lekar': 'Aashur se le kar',
    'Abbas akbar qasim asghar': 'Abbaas Akbar Qaasim Asghar',
    'gham tarpata': 'gham tarpaata',
    'meiṅ matam': 'meiṅ maatam',
    'sogh': 'sog',
    'Sajjad': 'Sajjaad',
    'aayenge': 'aayeṅge',
    'Ache bhaiya': 'Achchhe bhaiya',
    'jayenge': 'jaayeṅge',
    'kabhi amma se': 'kabhi ammaaṅ se',
}
metadata, roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
assert len(roman.splitlines()) == len(body.strip().splitlines()) == 48
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in roman)
after = (metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode()
assert before.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == after.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
p.write_bytes(after)
PY"
